clue.text: See 24
Barely covering the fundamentals of rules, insufficient for legal expert

indicators.note: the first piece covers, so wraps around, the letters that follow

parts.note: barely, as in only just, gives JUST

indicators.note: the fundamentals are the basics, here the opening letters of the next two words

explanation.surface: A lawyer's grasp of the rules is so thin it barely covers the basics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the fundamentals of' takes the first letters of 'rules' and 'insufficient', R and I, which 'covering' puts inside JUST.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a person learned in law, a legal scholar or judge.

clue.text: Nut pasta

definitions.meaning: a ribbon of pasta, as in chicken soup

explanation.surface: A short menu line for a nutty pasta dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: informal word for the head, and a strip of egg pasta.

clue.text: Baseball player shot due to rifle

indicators.note: shot means wrecked or broken, so the letters that follow are rearranged

explanation.surface: A baseball player gunned down by a rifle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' reads as gunfire with the rifle, but it signals the anagram of DUE TO RIFLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A fielder stationed in the outfield in baseball, one of left, centre or right field.

clue.text: Bottom of charts, not very good track

indicators.note: in a down clue the bottom of a word is its final letter

parts.note: not very good means poor

explanation.surface: A record languishing at the bottom of the charts is not very good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'track' looks like a song, given the charts, but means an animal's trail.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: the trail of footprints or droppings left by an animal.

clue.text: Most adequate unit of current, just in case

parts.note: the ampere, or amp, is the unit of electric current
lest means for fear that, just in case

explanation.surface: An electrician picks the most adequate rating, just to be safe.
explanation.definitionFit: Superlative of ample: the most sufficient or plentiful.

clue.text: For the future then? Yours truly, for starters

parts.note: being for the future can be read as being against the past, ANTI-PAST
yours truly is the setter speaking, I

explanation.surface: A forward-looking letter signed off 'yours truly', with a nod to a first course.
explanation.walkthrough: The question invites reading 'for the future' as opposed to the past, ANTI + PAST.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian hors d'oeuvres, the dishes served before the main meal.

clue.text: See 16
Will official survive in the end, after old court restructured?

indicators.note: the last letter of survive comes after the word for old

parts.note: ex means former, old

indicators.note: in the end picks the final letter of survive
restructured means the letters of court are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Does a will's official outlast an old court reorganisation?
explanation.walkthrough: 'restructured' rearranges the letters of 'court'; 'in the end' takes the final letter of 'survive', which goes after the word for old.
explanation.definitionFit: The person appointed in a will to carry out its terms.

clue.text: Tail of nuthatch in bird book

indicators.note: the final letter goes inside the bird's name

parts.note: the triller is a songbird of Australasia

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher's book picturing a nuthatch's tail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'book' seems a field guide, given the birds, but it is a suspense novel.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: a gripping suspense novel is one kind of book.

clue.text: Base including second home

indicators.note: the word for base takes in the abbreviation

parts.note: a base or source is a root

explanation.surface: A military base that includes a second home.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird's resting place, so loosely a place to settle for the night.

clue.text: True to form, runner put on old coat, perhaps?

indicators.note: to form means the letters of true are shaped into a new arrangement

parts.note: a runner is a river; the Wear flows through Durham

explanation.surface: A runner true to form pulls on an old coat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to form' turns TRUE into UTER; 'runner' is the River Wear in north-east England, not an athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: A coat is one example of clothing worn over everything else.

clue.text: See 18
See 19
Flash speed not good enough

parts.note: a flash is an instant, a second
speed means rate

explanation.surface: A camera flash whose speed falls short.
explanation.definitionFit: Inferior quality, below the best: an idiom for mediocre.

clue.text: A flavour eating donkey, part braised

indicators.note: the flavouring word swallows the animal

parts.note: to lace food is to flavour it, as with spirits
an ass is a donkey
an actor's part is a role

explanation.surface: A flavour so strong it is braised with part of a donkey.
explanation.definitionFit: A French phrase meaning cooked slowly in a covered dish, as a stew is.

clue.text: Old vessel, ship under contract, originally transporting yarn swiftly

indicators.note: in a down answer the vessel's letters sit below the rest

parts.note: to contract is to shorten, to cut

indicators.note: originally takes the first letters of the three words that follow

parts.note: Noah's ark is a ship

explanation.surface: An old ship under contract carries yarn quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' gives TYS; the clipper is apt, as it was built to carry tea swiftly.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous Victorian tea clipper, preserved at Greenwich in London.

clue.text: Irritating devil, perhaps, penning average score for 1960s' song

parts.note: irritating, as a rash is, means itchy

indicators.note: the cooking word pens, or encloses, the golf term

parts.note: to devil is to cook with hot spices, so devilling is one way to cook
par is the standard score in golf

explanation.surface: An irritating imp writing down an average score for a sixties hit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'devil' looks like an imp, but devilled food is cooked with spices.
explanation.definitionFit: A 1967 hit single by the Small Faces.

clue.text: Source of information in the Times about bird

indicators.note: the pair of letters go around the bird

parts.note: T is time, so times in the plural is TT
the erne is a sea eagle

explanation.surface: A newspaper item about a bird in The Times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the Times' looks like the newspaper but is two abbreviations for time.
explanation.definitionFit: The worldwide computer network is a vast modern source of facts.

clue.text: 8 unmasking red, risky operation still

indicators.note: unmasking exposes things, so the letters are laid out anew

explanation.surface: A spy story: a red agent is unmasked and the risky operation goes on.
explanation.walkthrough: '8' refers to the answer to 8-down, a book type. 'unmasking' signals the anagram, though it reads as exposing a Russian spy.
explanation.definitionFit: John le Carré's Cold War spy novel, a classic of the suspense genre.

clue.text: Be brave at first in bending the rule of law in advance notice of possible charges?

indicators.note: the opening letter of brave goes inside the rearranged phrase
bending the rules distorts them, so these letters are rearranged
at first takes the opening letter of brave

explanation.surface: A call to be brave in bending the law, with a hint of criminal charges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charges' suggests legal charges, but it means a bull's charges. 'bending' rearranges THE RULE OF LAW; 'at first' takes B from 'brave', placed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A warning sign on a field gate tells you in advance an animal may run at you.

clue.text: Lead key or bolt, ultimately

parts.note: Esc is the escape key on a keyboard

indicators.note: ultimately takes the last letter of bolt

explanation.surface: A lead, a key or a bolt: ways to secure something.
explanation.definitionFit: A verb synonym: to lead or accompany someone, guiding them.

clue.text: One's despicable list

definitions.meaning: a cad, someone who is despicable
a ship lists, leaning over to one side

explanation.surface: A despicable person's list.
explanation.definitionFit: A cad or rotter; also the verb for a ship tilting over.

clue.text: Well, what might have me beatified?

definitions.meaning: being beatified is a reward for virtue, so the speaker's virtue might bring it about

explanation.surface: Wondering aloud what saintly conduct might win you beatification.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of surprise, like 'well' or 'goodness me'.

clue.text: See 19
Soccer team from Louisiana, one beset by yobs

indicators.note: the word for yobs surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: yobs are louts, boors
Cajuns are the French-descended people of Louisiana
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A Louisiana football side whose player is surrounded by hooligans.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous football club of Buenos Aires, Maradona's old team.

clue.text: One isn't a worker behind party issue

indicators.note: the worker comes after, or behind, the other pieces

parts.note: Con is short for the Conservative Party
issue means offspring, a son
the ant is the classic worker insect

explanation.surface: A union man's complaint: he isn't a worker, just someone behind the party line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' is I, a vowel; the letter that isn't one belongs to the other class.
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic definition: the letter I, for one, is a vowel, which a non-vowel letter is not.

clue.text: Mission accomplished, like another military operation on all fronts

indicators.note: the front of each word is its first letter, taken from every word after the definition

explanation.surface: A boast of mission accomplished, likened to another military operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mission' is not part of the pick: the fronts start at 'accomplished'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Texas fort famously besieged in 1836 was originally a Spanish mission.

clue.text: Both journeys on a return ticket to remote location

definitions.text: Both journeys on a return ticket
definitions.meaning: a return ticket covers going there and coming home again
the sparsely settled interior of Australia

explanation.surface: A return ticket to somewhere far away.
explanation.definitionFit: Australia's remote, thinly populated interior; also the two legs of a round trip.

clue.text: Factor when last in race, fast catching me

indicators.note: when last in tells us to take only the letter that finishes the word race, the runner coming home last
the fasting season catches, so holds, the word me

parts.note: Lent is the Christian season of fasting

explanation.surface: A sprinter's factor: running last but fast enough to catch me.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a component or contributing part of a whole.
